in_marathi.name: Sv
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sv हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'svā', meaning 'self', 'one's own'. It signifies the individual's unique and independent existence, and is often used as a prefix for personal names in Hindu culture.
